M8d.text: vayyiqra far`oh le'avram vayyómer mah-zot `asíta li lámmah lo-higgádta li ki ishtekha hi lamah amárta achóti hi va'eqqach otah li le'ishshah ve`attah hinneh ishtekha qach valekh vayetsav `alav par`oh anashim vayeshallechu oto ve'et-ishto ve'et-kol-asher-lo

vayyómer elohim el-avraham saray ishtekha lo-tiqra et-shemah saray ki sarah shemah uverakhti otah vegam natátti mimménnah lekha ben uverakhtíha vehayetah legoyim malkhe `ammim mimménnah yihyu vayyippol avraham `al-panav vayyitschaq vayyómer belibbo halleven me'ah-shanah yivvaled ve'im-sarah havat-tish`im shanah teled

vayyómer avimélekh el-avraham mah ra'íta ki `asíta et-haddavar hazzeh vayyómer avraham ki amárti raq en-yir'at elohim bammaqom hazzeh vaharagúni `al-devar ishti vegam-omnah achoti vat-avi hi akh lo vat-immi vattehi-li le'ishshah vayehi ka'asher hit`u oti elohim mibbet avi va'omar lah zeh chasdekh asher ta`asi `immadi el kol-hammaqom asher navo shámmah imri-li achi hu

vattitten et-hammat`ammim ve'et-halléchem asher `asátah beyad ya`aqov benah vayyavo el-aviv vayyómer avi vayyómer hinnénni mi attah beni vayyómer ya`aqov el-aviv anokhi `esav bekhorékha `asíti ka'asher dibbárta elay qum-na shevah ve'okhlah mitstsedi ba`avur tevarakhánni nafshékha

vayyiqra yitschaq el-ya`aqov vayevárekh oto vayetsavvéhu vayyómer lo lo-tiqqach ishshah mibbenot kená`an qum lekh paddénah aram bétah vetu'el avi immékha veqach-lekha mishsham ishshah mibbenot lavan achi immékha ve'el shadday yevarekh otekha veyafrekha veyarbékha vehayíta liqhal `ammim

vattiqra et-shemo yosef lemor yosef YHWH li ben acher vayehi ka'asher yaledah rachel et-yosef vayyómer ya`aqov el-lavan shallechéni ve'elekhah el-meqomi ule'artsi tenah et-nashay ve'et-yeladay asher `avádti otekha bahen ve'elékhah ki attah yadá`ta et-`avodati asher `avadtíkha

vayyomer-lo elohim shimkha ya`aqov lo-yiqqare shimkha `od ya`aqov ki im-yisra'el yihyeh shemékha vayyiqra et-shemo yisra'el vayyómer lo elohim ani el shadday pereh ureveh goy uqehal goyim yihyeh mimmékka umelakhim mechalatsékha yetsé'u ve'et-ha'árets asher natátti le'avraham uleyitschaq lekha ettenénnah ulezar`akha acharékha etten et-ha'árets vayyá`al me`alav elohim bammaqom asher-dibber itto

hen késef asher matsánu befi amtechoténu heshivónu elékha me'érets kená`an ve'ekh nignov mibbet adonékha késef o zahav asher yimmatse itto me`avadékha vamet vegam-anáchnu nihyeh ladoni la`avadim vayyómer gam-`attah khedivrekhem ken-hu asher yimmatse itto yihyeh-li `áved ve'attem tihyu neqiyyim

ki `avdekha `arav et-hanná`ar me`im avi lemor im-lo avi'énnu elékha vechatáti le'avi kol-hayyamim ve`attah yeshev-na `avdekha táchat hanná`ar `éved ladoni vehanná`ar yá`al `im-echav ki-ekh e`eleh el-avi vehanná`ar enénnu itti pen er'eh vara` asher yimtsa et-avi

vayyómer YHWH el-mosheh re'eh netattíkha elohim lefar`oh ve'aharon achíkha yihyeh nevi'ékha attah tedabber et kol-asher atsavvékka ve'aharon achíkha yedabber el-par`oh veshillach et-bene-yisra'el me'artso va'ani aqsheh et-lev par`oh vehirbeti et-ototay ve'et-mofetay be'érets mitsráyim velo-yishma` alekhem par`oh venatatti et-yadi bemitsráyim vehotseti et-tsiv'otay et-`ammi vene-yisra'el me'érets mitsráyim bishfatim gedolim

vayyómer YHWH el-mosheh ve'el-aharon lemor ki yedabber alekhem par`oh lemor tenu lakhem mofet ve'amarta el-aharon qach et-mattekha vehashlekh lifne-far`oh yehi letannin vayyavo mosheh ve'aharon el-par`oh vayyá`asu khen ka'asher tsivvah YHWH vayyashlekh aharon et-mattéhu lifne far`oh velifne `avadav vayehi letannin

ushemartem et-haddavar hazzeh lechoq-lekha ulevanékha `ad-`olam vehayah ki-tavó'u el-ha'árets asher yitten YHWH lakhem ka'asher dibber ushemartem et-ha`avodah hazzot vehayah ki-yomeru alekhem benekhem mah ha`avodah hazzot lakhem

vayyis`u merefidim vayyavó'u midbar sinay vayyachanu bammidbar vayyichan-sham yisra'el néged hahar umosheh `alah el-ha'elohim vayyiqra elav YHWH min-hahar lemor koh tomar levet ya`aqov vetagged livne yisra'el attem re'item asher `asíti lemitsráyim va'essa etkhem `al-kanfe nesharim va'avi etkhem elay

vayedabber elohim et kol-haddevarim ha'élleh lemor anokhi YHWH elohékha asher hotsetíkha me'érets mitsráyim mibbet `avadim lo yihyeh-lekha elohim acherim `al-panáya lo ta`aseh-lekha fésel vekhol-temunah asher bashshamáyim mimmá`al va'asher ba'árets mittáchat va'asher bammáyim mittáchat la'árets

vayyómer YHWH el-mosheh koh tomar el-bene yisra'el attem re'item ki min-hashshamáyim dibbárti `immakhem lo ta`asun itti elóhe khésef velohe zahav lo ta`asu lakhem mizbach adamah ta`aseh-li vezavachta `alav et-`olotékha ve'et-shelamékha et-tsonekha ve'et-beqarékha bekhol-hammaqom asher azkir et-shemi avo elékha uverakhtíkha

ve`asíta et-haqqerashim lammishkan `esrim qéresh lif'at négbah temánah ve'arba`im adne-khésef ta`aseh táchat `esrim haqqáresh shene adanim tachat-haqqéresh ha'echad lishte yedotav ushene adanim tachat-haqqéresh ha'echad lishte yedotav uletséla` hammishkan hashshenit lif'at tsafon `esrim qáresh ve'arba`im adnehem kásef shene adanim táchat haqqéresh ha'echad ushene adanim táchat haqqéresh ha'echad uleyarkete hammishkan yámmah ta`aseh shishshah qerashim

vayyómer mosheh el-aharon meh-`asah lekha ha`am hazzeh ki-hevéta `alav chata'ah gedolah vayyómer aharon al-yíchar af adoni attah yadá`ta et-ha`am ki vera` hu vayyómeru li `aseh-lánu elohim asher yelekhu lefanénu ki-zeh mosheh ha'ish asher he`elánu me'érets mitsráyim lo yadá`nu meh-háyah lo

venatattah et mizbach ha`olah lifne pétach mishkan ohel-mo`ed venatatta et-hakkiyyor ben-óhel mo`ed uven hammizbéach venatatta sham máyim vesamta et-hechatser saviv venatatta et-masakh shá`ar hechatser velaqachta et-shémen hammishchah umashachta et-hammishkan ve'et-kol-asher-bo veqiddashta oto ve'et-kol-kelav veháyah qódesh umashachta et-mizbach ha`olah ve'et-kol-kelav veqiddashta et-hammizbéach vehayah hammizbéach qódesh qodashim

vayyómer YHWH el-mosheh peqod kol-bekhor zakhar livne yisra'el mibben-chódesh vamá`elah vesa et mispar shemotam velaqachta et-halviyyim li ani YHWH táchat kol-bekhor bivne yisra'el ve'et behemat halviyyim táchat kol-bekhor bevehemat bene yisra'el vayyifqod mosheh ka'asher tsivvah YHWH oto et-kol-bekhor bivne yisra'el

veyaradti vedibbarti `immekha sham ve'atsalti min-harúach asher `alékha vesamti `alehem venase'u ittekha bemassa ha`am velo-tissa attah levaddékha ve'el-ha`am tomar hitqaddeshu lemachar va'akhaltem basar ki bekhítem be'ozne YHWH lemor mi ya'akhilénu basar ki-tov lánu bemitsráyim venatan YHWH lakhem basar va'akhaltem lo yom echad tokhelun velo yomáyim velo chamishshah yamim velo `asarah yamim velo `esrim yom

vayyishma` mosheh vayyippol `al-panav vayedabber el-qórach ve'el-kol-`adato lemor bóqer veyoda` YHWH et-asher-lo ve'et-haqqadosh vehiqriv elav ve'et asher yivchar-bo yaqriv elav zot `asu qechu-lakhem machtot qórach vekhol-`adato

dabber el-ha`edah lemor he`alu missaviv lemishkan-qórach datan va'aviram vayyáqom mosheh vayyélekh el-datan va'aviram vayyelekhu acharav ziqne yisra'el vayedabber el-ha`edah lemor súru na me`al ohole ha'anashim haresha`im ha'élleh ve'al-tigge`u bekhol-asher lahem pen-tissafu bekhol-chattotam

dabber el-bene yisra'el veqach me'ittam matteh matteh levet av me'et kol-nesi'ehem levet avotam shenem `asar mattot ish et-shemo tikhtov `al-mattéhu ve'et shem aharon tikhtov `al-matteh levi ki matteh echad lerosh bet avotam vehinnachtam be'óhel mo`ed lifne ha`edut asher ivva`ed lakhem shámmah

vayyis`u miqqadesh vayyavó'u vene-yisra'el kol-ha`edah hor hahar vayyómer YHWH el-mosheh ve'el-aharon behor hahar `al-gevul erets-edom lemor ye'asef aharon el-`ammav ki lo yavo el-ha'árets asher natátti livne yisra'el `al asher-meritem et-pi leme merivah qach et-aharon ve'et-el`azar beno vehá`al otam hor hahar
ve'el-bene yisra'el tedabber lemor ish ki-yamut uven en lo veha`avartem et-nachalato levitto ve'im-en lo bat unetattem et-nachalato le'echav ve'im-en lo achim unetattem et-nachalato la'ache aviv

ve'im-en achim le'aviv unetattem et-nachalato lish'ero haqqarov elav mimmishpachto veyarash otah vehayetah livne yisra'el lechuqqat mishpat ka'asher tsivvah YHWH et-mosheh vayyómer YHWH el-mosheh `aleh el-har ha`avarim hazzeh ure'eh et-ha'árets asher natátti livne yisra'el vera'ítah otah vene'esafta el-`ammékha gam-áttah ka'asher ne'esaf aharon achíkha

veha`amadta oto lifne el`azar hakkohen velifne kol-ha`edah vetsivvitah oto le`enehem venatattah mehodekha `alav lemá`an yishme`u kol-`adat bene yisra'el velifne el`azar hakkohen ya`amod veshá'al lo bemishpat ha'urim lifne YHWH `al-piv yetse'u ve`al-piv yavó'u hu vekhol-bene-yisra'el itto vekhol-ha`edah vayyá`as mosheh ka'asher tsivvah YHWH oto vayyiqqach et-yehoshúa` vayya`amidéhu lifne el`azar hakkohen velifne kol-ha`edah

vayyavó'u vene-gad uvene re'uven vayyomeru el-mosheh ve'el-el`azar hakkohen ve'el-nesi'e ha`edah lemor `atarot vedivon veya`zer venimrah vecheshbon ve'el`aleh usevam unevo uve`on ha'árets asher hikkah YHWH lifne `adat yisra'el érets miqneh hi vela`avadékha miqneh vayyomeru im-matsánu chen be`enékha yuttan et-ha'árets hazzot la`avadékha la'achuzzah al-ta`avirénu et-hayyarden vayyómer mosheh livne-gad velivne re'uven ha'achekhem yavó'u lammilchamah ve'attem téshevu foh

venasav haggevul me`atsmon náchlah mitsráyim vehayu totse'otav hayyámmah ugevul yam vehayah lakhem hayyam haggadol ugevul zeh-yihyeh lakhem gevul yam vezeh-yihyeh lakhem gevul tsafon min-hayyam haggadol teta'u lakhem hor hahar

vannishma` vayyimmas levavénu velo-qámah `od rúach be'ish mippenekhem ki YHWH elohekhem hu elohim bashshamáyim mimmá`al ve`al-ha'árets mittáchat ve`attah hishshave`u-na li baYHWH ki-`asíti `immakhem chásed va`asitem gam-attem `im-bet avi chésed unetattem li ot emet vehachayitem et-avi ve'et-immi ve'et-achay ve'et-achyotay ve'et kol-asher lahem vehitstsaltem et-nafshoténu mimmávet

az yiqra yehoshúa` lar'uveni velaggadi velachatsi matteh menashsheh vayyómer alehem attem shemartem et kol-asher tsivvah etkhem mosheh `éved YHWH vattishme`u veqoli lekhol asher-tsivvíti etkhem lo-`azavtem et-achekhem zeh yamim rabbim `ad hayyom hazzeh ushemartem et-mishméret mitsvat YHWH elohekhem

ve`attah hasíru et-elohe hannekhar asher beqirbekhem vehattu et-levavkhem el-YHWH elohe yisra'el vayyomeru ha`am el-yehoshúa` et-YHWH elohénu na`avod uveqolo nishma` vayyikhrot yehoshúa` berit la`am bayyom hahu vayyásem lo choq umishpat bishkhem

vattishlach vattiqra levaraq ben-avinó`am miqqédesh naftali vattómer elav halo tsivvah YHWH elohe-yisra'el lekh umashakhta behar tavor velaqachta `immekha `aséret alafim ish mibbene naftali umibbene zevulun umashakhti elékha el-náchal qishon et-sisera sar-tseva yavin ve'et-rikhbo ve'et-hamono unetattíhu beyadékha vayyómer eléha baraq im-telekhi `immi vehalákheti ve'im-lo telekhi `immi lo elekh

vayyómer lo YHWH shalom lekha al-tira lo tamut vayyíven sham gid`on mizbéach laYHWH vayyiqra-lo YHWH shalom `ad hayyom hazzeh `odénnu be`ofrat avi ha`ezri vayehi balláylah hahu vayyómer lo YHWH qach et-par-hashshor asher le'avíkha ufar hashsheni shéva` shanim veharasta et-mizbach habbá`al asher le'avíkha ve'et-ha'asherah asher-`alav tikhrot

asher-nilcham avi `alekhem vayyashlekh et-nafsho minnéged vayyatstsel etkhem miyyad midyan ve'attem qamtem `al-bet avi hayyom vattahargu et-banav shiv`im ish `al-éven echat vattamlíkhu et-avimélekh ben-amato `al-ba`ale shekhem ki achikhem hu ve'im-be'emet uvetamim `asitem `im-yerubbá`al ve`im-beto hayyom hazzeh simchu ba'avimélekh veyismach gam-hu bakhem ve'im-áyin tétse esh me'avimélekh vetokhal et-ba`ale shekhem ve'et-bet millo vetetse esh mibba`ale shekhem umibbet millo vetokhal et-avimélekh

vayyireshu et kol-gevul ha'emori me'arnon ve`ad-hayyabboq umin-hammidbar ve`ad-hayyarden ve`attah YHWH elohe yisra'el horish et-ha'emori mippene `ammo yisra'el ve'attah tirashénnu halo et asher yorishekha kemosh elohékha oto tirash ve'et kol-asher horish YHWH elohénu mippanénu oto nirash

vayyómer mal'akh YHWH el-manóach im-ta`tseréni lo-okhal belachmékha ve'im-ta`aseh `olah laYHWH ta`alénnah ki lo-yada` manóach ki-mal'akh YHWH hu vayyómer manóach el-mal'akh YHWH mi shemékha ki-yavo devarekha vekhibbadnúkha vayyómer lo mal'akh YHWH lámmah zeh tish'al lishmi vehu-féliy

vattir'u ki-nachash mélekh bene-`ammon ba `alekhem vattómeru li lo ki-mélekh yimlokh `alénu vaYHWH elohekhem malkekhem ve`attah hinneh hammélekh asher bechartem asher she'eltem vehinneh natan YHWH `alekhem mélekh im-tire'u et-YHWH va`avadtem oto ushema`tem beqolo velo tamru et-pi YHWH vihyitem gam-attem vegam-hammélekh asher malakh `alekhem achar YHWH elohekhem

vayyómer david el-yehonatan mi yaggid li o mah-ya`ankha avíkha qashah vayyómer yehonatan el-david lekhah venetse hassadeh vayyetse'u shenehem hassadeh vayyómer yehonatan el-david YHWH elohe yisra'el ki-echqor et-avi ka`et machar hashshelishit vehinneh-tov el-david velo-az eshlach elékha vegalíti et-oznékha

ve`attah ya`as-YHWH `immakhem chésed ve'emet vegam anokhi e`eseh ittekhem hattovah hazzot asher `asitem haddavar hazzeh ve`attah techezáqnah yedekhem vihyu livne-cháyil ki-met adonekhem sha'ul vegam-oti mashechu vet-yehudah lemélekh `alehem ve'avner ben-ner sar-tsava asher lesha'ul laqach et-ish bóshet ben-sha'ul vayya`aviréhu machanáyim

vayyilláchem yo'av berabbat bene `ammon vayyilkod et-`ir hammelukhah vayyishlach yo'av mal'akhim el-david vayyómer nilchámti verabbah gam-lakhádti et-`ir hammáyim ve`attah esof et-yéter ha`am vachaneh `al-ha`ir velokhdah pen-elkod ani et-ha`ir veniqra shemi `aléha

vahalo `immekha sham tsadoq ve'evyatar hakkohanim vehayah kol-haddavar asher tishma` mibbet hammélekh taggid letsadoq ule'evyatar hakkohanim hinneh-sham `immam shene venehem achimá`ats letsadoq vihonatan le'evyatar ushelachtem beyadam elay kol-davar asher tishmá`u vayyavo chushay re`eh david ha`ir ve'avshalom yavo yerushaláyim

vayyómer avshalom el-chushay zeh chasdekha et-re`ékha lámmah lo-halákhta et-re`ékha vayyómer chushay el-avshalom lo ki asher bachar YHWH veha`am hazzeh vekhol-ish yisra'el lo ehyeh ve'itto eshev vehashshenit lemi ani e`evod halo lifne veno ka'asher `avádti lifne avíkha ken ehyeh lefanékha

ki ka'asher nishbá`ti lakh baYHWH elohe yisra'el lemor ki-shelomoh venekh yimlokh acharay vehu yeshev `al-kis'i tachtay ki ken e`eseh hayyom hazzeh vattiqqod bat-shéva` appáyim érets vattishtáchu lammélekh vattómer yechi adoni hammélekh david le`olam vayyómer hammélekh david qir'u-li letsadoq hakkohen ulenatan hannavi velivnayáhu ben-yehoyada` vayyavó'u lifne hammélekh

vayyómer eliyyáhu el-ha`am ani notárti navi laYHWH levaddi unevi'e habbá`al arba`-me'ot vachamishshim ish veyittenu-lánu shenáyim parim veyivcharu lahem happar ha'echad vinattechúhu veyasímu `al-ha`etsim ve'esh lo yasímu va'ani e`eseh et-happar ha'echad venatatti `al-ha`etsim ve'esh lo asim uqeratem beshem elohekhem va'ani eqra veshem-YHWH vehayah ha'elohim asher-ya`aneh va'esh hu ha'elohim vayyá`an kol-ha`am vayyomeru tov haddavar vayyómer eliyyáhu linvi'e habbá`al bacharu lakhem happar ha'echad va`asu rishonah ki attem harabbim veqir'u beshem elohekhem ve'esh lo tasímu

vayyissa`er lev melekh-aram `al-haddavar hazzeh vayyiqra el-`avadav vayyómer alehem halo taggídu li mi mishshellánu el-mélekh yisra'el vayyómer achad me`avadav lo adoni hammélekh ki-elisha` hannavi asher beyisra'el yaggid lemélekh yisra'el et-haddevarim asher tedabber bachadar mishkavékha vayyómer lekhu ure'u ekhoh hu ve'eshlach ve'eqqachéhu vayyuggad-lo lemor hinneh vedotan

venatenu et-elohehem ba'esh ki lo elohim hémmah ki im-ma`aseh yede-adam `ets va'éven vaye'abbedum ve`attah YHWH elohénu hoshi`énu na miyyado veyede`u kol-mamlekhot ha'árets ki attah YHWH elohim levaddékha vayyishlach yesha`yáhu ven-amots el-chizqiyyáhu lemor koh-amar YHWH elohe yisra'el asher hitpallálta elay el-sancheriv melekh-ashshur shamá`eti
